project: Janardhan Textiles — Three 360° Scroll-Controlled Saree Design Galleries

generationSummary.note: Each gallery maps positions 001..360 one-to-one to viewing angles 0°..359° across a full 360° mannequin turn built from the 24 Nano Banana 2 Pro studio angle keyframes, with garment-isolated CIELAB colorway and zari styling matched 100% to each design's title and product metadata.
